title: I Turned $50 Into $3,754 In 21 Days Trading Futures
summary: A futures trader runs a challenge staking a small account on each trade, stops after a few wins, and offers a candlestick guide.

assertions.quote: If I double $50 just 10 times, it's over $50,000.

verdicts.note: Taiwan stock day traders 1992-2006: fewer than 1% (about 1,000 of 360,000 a year) outperform persistently, and the top 500 by prior-year return earn 28.1 bps a day after fees on their day trading (roughly 6% over a trading month), so skilled experienced day traders exist but their documented group edge is nowhere near multiplying an account in a month; it is a value-weighted group average whose magnitude the authors say leverage or sequential trading could change, not momentum-stock specific.

assertions.quote: showing you what's possible if you follow a disciplined, consistent strategy
It's made a clean double bottom. We're at a good support and it's broken this downtrend.
my free guide that goes through all the candlestick patterns that I use
